items.title: Somehow It Makes Perfect Sense That What Jensen Huang Inspires in Trump Is ... Empathy
items.content: On the one hand, it’s empathy for a philanderer who may have compromised national security. On the other hand, between this and the interview, displaying real human emotion twice in one week might be a new record.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s Shoes Were the Tell
items.content: I like men’s shoes and I’ve sold men’s shoes. A man’s footwear reveals facets of his public persona—and his private desires.

items.title: The Blue Tsunami Made Waves in Ways I Didn’t Expect, but I’m More Than Glad to See It
items.content: Sure, some elections touched upon the second-worst idea in American politics. But we have to take the wins when we can.

items.title: I Can Feel the Tremors of History Rumbling Beneath Scott Colom’s Victory
items.content: The senator-elect from Mississippi invoked Medger Evers in his winning speech, which reminded me of how far we’ve come—and how far we still have to go.

items.title: The White House to Rep. Robert Garcia: “Please Stop Picking On the President!”
items.content: In a hilariously worded letter, Trump’s counsel claims that the incoming House oversight-committee chair has been making “abusive” threats. Okay then.

items.title: Happy Holidays! The Trump Administration Is Cutting Food-Assistance Programs Again!
items.content: The GOP loses spectacularly, then immediately decides to do as much damage as possible before the Democrats take over. Why am I not surprised?

items.title: I Guess We’re Going Have to Deal with Pete Hegseth for Another Two Months
items.content: The House vote to impeach the Secretary of Talking About War failed yesterday, partially because Democratic members were stuck in traffic and missed it. Great work by all.

items.title: House Republicans Couldn’t Have Picked a Worse Minority Speaker
items.content: So much for cleaning house. Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio has been a loyal foot soldier of the MAGA regime for years now.

items.title: I Have No Intention of Celebrating the Blue Tsunami Until Scott Colom Is Officially Elected
items.content: And haste is now required, because the election-denying harpies are once again gathering in the lush canopies of the Intertube forests.

items.title: Why Is It So Hard to Call Out Your Buddy?
items.content: Your friend does something terrible. You know you should say something, but you don’t. There’s a reason for that.

items.title: The List of Possible Democratic Senate Committee Chairs Looks a Bit, Well, Old
items.content: Let’s worry about the septuagenarians and octogenarians later. For now, let’s grab some popcorn and watch them get to work.

items.title: Ron DeSantis Suddenly Thinks He’s a Big Shot Because Florida Republicans Barely Survived the Blue Tsunami
items.content: With a little more money and effort, the Democrats could have shut the charisma-proof Florida governor up for good.

items.title: Wow, Trump Actually Comes Within Shouting Distance of Empathy During His 60 Minutes Interview
items.content: Then, of course, the president does something to remind us who he really is.

items.title: My Life as an Asylum Seeker in the U.S.
items.content: I came here 11 years ago to give my daughter a better life. I believe in the American dream, even if the American government doesn’t want me here.

items.title: Trump Has Blamed Everyone for the GOP’s Midterm Meltdown—Except Himself and the Worst Member of His Staff
items.content: Maybe the president shouldn’t have told everyone to pretend he was on the ballot.

items.title: This Mississippi Senate Race Is Really Making Me Nervous
items.content: With how tight the margin is between Democratic candidate Scott Colom and Republican candidate Cindy Hyde-Smith, every single vote counts.

items.title: One of My Least Favorite Politicians Lost an Election This Week. I Can’t Stop Laughing About It.
items.content: This guy was an ur-Trumper before Trump, and I’m so glad we’re rid of him.

items.title: Meet Texas’s Newly Elected Attorney General, Who Wants to Put a Stop to Elon Musk’s Greedy Billionaire Hijinks
items.content: Nathan Johnson has promised to investigate SpaceX, and I can’t wait to see what he finds.

items.title: Good Riddance, Harmeet Dhillon. You Won’t Be Missed.
items.content: The head of the DOJ’s civil-rights division resigned Thursday. But not to worry. I suspect we’ll see her again—in a congressional hearing room.

items.title: The Remarkable Election-Night Story We Should All Be Talking About
items.content: Don’t let the sound of the blue tsunami drown out what happened in Wisconsin.

items.title: The GOP Is Already Counting Down the Days Until Trump Is Gone
items.content: It only took a historic loss to wake these yahoos up.

items.title: The Democratic Party Has Rediscovered the Power of Christianity. The GOP Should Be Worried.
items.content: James Talarico of Texas and Adam Hamilton of Kansas have proven that faith isn’t just a Republican value.

items.title: The Republican Party Failed Deliciously Last Night. Now the Real Work Begins.
items.content: Lawyer up, MAGA. Your hell has only just begun.
